background_setting: A quiet suburban two-lane road under clear, bright daytime skies. On either side are low residential and light-green vegetation borders: grassy verges, occasional trees casting consistent shadows, mailboxes, driveways, and modest houses set back from the road. The pavement is faded grey with age, marked by cracks and older repair scars. A vanishing point recedes toward a gentle rise and distant tree line under a mostly clear blue sky with a few scattered clouds.
